::: {.hero-banner .text-center style="padding: 3rem 1rem 2rem;"}
# do2screen <span style="font-size:0.5em; color:#6c757d;">v5.0</span>

### Review any section of your Stata do-file — directly in the console

Ever lost track of how a variable was built across a thousand-line script?  
**do2screen** puts all the relevant code in one place, instantly.

::: {style="margin-top: 1.5rem;"}
```stata
github install randrescastaneda/do2screen
```
:::

::: {style="margin-top: 1rem;"}
[Get Started](get-started.qmd){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg}
[Reference](reference.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-secondary .btn-lg}
:::
:::

---

## What do2screen does

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### 🔍 Variable Tracing

Trace exactly how a variable was created and modified — including all parent variables. No more scrolling through thousands of lines.

```stata
do2screen using "analysis.do", ///
    var(pchincome)
```
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### 🔎 String Search

Find every occurrence of a word or phrase in your do-file, with configurable lines of context around each match.

```stata
do2screen using "analysis.do", ///
    find("poverty line") lines(10)
```
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### 📄 Line Range

Display any block of lines from your do-file — by start/end line numbers or by start + count.

```stata
do2screen using "analysis.do", ///
    range(253 263)
```
:::

:::

## Quick install

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Recommended (via `github`)

First install the [`github`](https://github.com/haghish/github) package by E. F. Haghish, then install `do2screen`:

```stata
net install github, from("https://haghish.github.io/github/")
github install randrescastaneda/do2screen
```

### Direct (net install)

```stata
net install do2screen, ///
    from("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/randrescastaneda/do2screen/master/") ///
    replace
```

:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## Requires Stata 16.1 or higher
`do2screen` v5.0 uses Stata [frames](https://www.stata.com/manuals/dframes.pdf) for internal data handling.
:::
